label: Finite grounding rank of actual concreta: ActualGroundingFiniteRank m w: some function rank from…
term: finite grounding rank of actual concreta
definition: ActualGroundingFiniteRank m w: some function rank from candidates to natural numbers decreases along every actual concrete grounding edge at w (if actual concretum y grounds actual concretum x, rank y < rank x). Ordinary meaning: every actual concretum sits at a finite grounding level. Example: a stack of three blocks, ranked 0, 1, 2 from the bottom. Counterexample: one concretum grounding itself; or an omega+1 hierarchy in which a top element is grounded by every finite level (well-founded, but with no Nat rank). Structural properties: implies well-founded actual grounding (ACTUAL-GROUNDING-WF-FROM-FINITE-RANK) and so irreflexivity and asymmetry; strictly stronger than well-foundedness. It concerns only actual concrete edges at w.
note: Stipulative analyst framework premise, attribution deferred. Compare DEF-ACTUAL-GROUNDING-WF (the weaker version) and TruthCore.Causality.CommonPriority.CommonRank, which deliberately allows any well-founded rank. Rival: an infinite past series of grounds or a transfinite grounding hierarchy rejects it.
